hook.en: By 1896 four Malay states each had a British Resident, but they were run in four different ways. Britain's answer was to join them into one federation — with the real power in Kuala Lumpur.
hook.bm: Menjelang 1896 empat negeri Melayu masing-masing mempunyai Residen British, tetapi ditadbir dengan empat cara berbeza. Jawapan British ialah menggabungkan negeri-negeri itu menjadi satu persekutuan — dengan kuasa sebenar di Kuala Lumpur.

bigIdeas.en: The Federated Malay States (1896) joined Perak, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan and Pahang under a Resident-General.
bigIdeas.bm: Negeri-negeri Melayu Bersekutu (1896) menggabungkan Perak, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan dan Pahang di bawah seorang Residen Jeneral.

bigIdeas.en: The Bangkok Treaty (1909) moved Kedah, Perlis, Kelantan and Terengganu from Siam to Britain; Johor accepted a General Adviser in 1914.
bigIdeas.bm: Perjanjian Bangkok (1909) memindahkan Kedah, Perlis, Kelantan dan Terengganu dari Siam kepada British; Johor menerima Penasihat Am pada 1914.

bigIdeas.en: The Unfederated Malay States had British Advisers and kept more independence than the federated states.
bigIdeas.bm: Negeri-negeri Melayu Tidak Bersekutu mempunyai Penasihat British dan mengekalkan lebih banyak kebebasan berbanding negeri bersekutu.

cells.en: Very limited; central control from Kuala Lumpur
cells.bm: Sangat terhad; kawalan pusat dari Kuala Lumpur
Lebih besar; lebih banyak kawalan tempatan

definition.en: Perak, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan and Pahang, united in 1896.
definition.bm: Perak, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan dan Pahang, disatukan pada 1896.

definition.en: Head of the FMS administration in Kuala Lumpur.
definition.bm: Ketua pentadbiran NNMB di Kuala Lumpur.

definition.en: Conference of the FMS rulers (first held at Kuala Kangsar in 1897).
definition.bm: Persidangan raja-raja NNMB (pertama kali di Kuala Kangsar pada 1897).

definition.en: British officer in an unfederated state.
definition.bm: Pegawai British di negeri tidak bersekutu.

definition.en: Siam transferred its rights over Kedah, Perlis, Kelantan and Terengganu to Britain.
definition.bm: Siam memindahkan haknya ke atas Kedah, Perlis, Kelantan dan Terengganu kepada British.

question.en: Compare the FMS and the Unfederated Malay States in TWO aspects.
question.bm: Bandingkan NNMB dan NNMTB dari DUA aspek.

steps.en: British officer: FMS had Residents under a Resident-General, whereas the UMS had British Advisers.
steps.bm: Pegawai British: NNMB mempunyai Residen di bawah Residen Jeneral, manakala NNMTB mempunyai Penasihat British.

steps.en: Rulers' power: FMS rulers had very little power, whereas UMS rulers kept more control over their states.
steps.bm: Kuasa raja: raja NNMB mempunyai kuasa yang sangat sedikit, manakala raja NNMTB mengekalkan lebih banyak kawalan.

answer.en: Use "whereas" to show both sides in each comparison.
answer.bm: Gunakan "manakala" untuk menunjukkan kedua-dua pihak dalam setiap perbandingan.
